macros.name: arraycolor
macros.doc: • The command \arraycolor takes in as mandatory argument a color and color the whole tabular with that color (except the potential exterior rows and columns: cf. 9, p. 36).

macros.name: chessboardcolors
macros.doc: The command \chessboardcolors takes in as mandatory arguments two colors and it colors the cells of the tabular in quincunx with these colors.

macros.name: EmptyColumn
macros.doc: The command \EmptyColumn takes in as argument a (comma-separated) list of numbers of columns and requires that no rule nor background colors will be drawn in the corresponding columns.

macros.name: Hspace
macros.doc: This command \Hspace is a command defined by the package nicematrix with the same meaning as \hspace except that the cell where it is used is considered as empty.

macros.name: Hspace*
macros.doc: This command \Hspace is a command defined by the package nicematrix with the same meaning as \hspace except that the cell where it is used is considered as empty.

macros.name: line
macros.doc: The command \line draws directly dotted lines between cells or blocks.

macros.name: line

macros.name: NiceMatrixLastEnv
macros.doc: The command \NiceMatrixLastEnv provides the number of the last environment of nicematrix (for LaTeX, it’s a “fully expandable” command and not a counter).

macros.name: NotEmpty
macros.doc: It’s possible to use the command \NotEmpty to specify explicitly that a cell must be considered as non empty by nicematrix (the TikZ nodes are constructed only in the non empty cells).

macros.name: OnlyMainNiceMatrix
macros.doc: The command \OnlyMainNiceMatrix executes its argument only when it is in the main part of the array, that is to say when it is not in one of the exterior rows or one of the exterior columns.

macros.name: OverBrace
macros.doc: The commands \OverBrace and \UnderBrace provide a way to put horizontal braces on a part of the array.

macros.name: OverBrace
macros.doc: The commands \OverBrace and \UnderBrace provide a way to put horizontal braces on a part of the array.

macros.name: rotate
macros.doc: When used in the beginning of a cell, this command composes the contents of the cell after a rotation of 90° in the direct sens.

macros.name: rotate

macros.name: rowlistcolors
macros.doc: The extension nicematrix provides also a command \rowlistcolors. This command generalises the command \rowcolors: instead of two successive arguments for the colors, this command takes in an argument which is a (comma-separated) list of colors.

macros.name: RowStyle
macros.doc: The command \RowStyle takes in as argument some formatting instructions that will be applied to each cell on the rest of the current row.

macros.name: RowStyle

macros.name: ShowCellNames
macros.doc: The command \ShowCellNames, which may be used in the \CodeBefore and in the \CodeAfter displays the name (with the form i-j) of each cell.

macros.name: tabularnote
macros.doc: The package nicematrix also provides a command \tabularnote which gives the ability to specify notes that will be composed at the end of the array with a width of text equal to the width of the array (except the potential exterior columns specified by first-col and last-col: cf. 9, p. 36).

envs.name: NiceArray
envs.doc: The environments {NiceArray}, {NiceTabular} and {NiceTabular*} are similar to the environments {array}, {tabular} and {tabular*} of the package array (which is loaded by nicematrix).

envs.name: NiceTabularX
envs.doc: For sake of similarity with the environment {tabularx}, nicematrix also provides an environment {NiceTabularX} with a syntax similar to the syntax of {tabularx}, that is to say with a first mandatory argument which is the width of the tabular.
